name: Default
shortDescription: Browser-based image editor built in Rust and WebAssembly: layers, masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, type, vectors, brushes and PSD open and save.

alerts.message: Images are not stored on the server: the editor runs in the browser and has no autosave. Save or export your work to your own device before closing the tab.
The upstream project publishes no container image; this one is built by a community maintainer from the official releases.
